name: RSSB
recent: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad 在2026年11月提出收购 Q Centre Management，以扩展工人住宿管理业务，并发布2027财年首季业绩，净利按季增长52.3%至247.9万令吉。同期，公司宣布将于12月16日召开第32届常年股东大会，并有多名董事在闭市期间申报交易持股。
notable: 公司提出收购 Q Centre Management，以进军工人住宿管理业务。
公司发布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利按季增长52.3%至247.9万令吉。
公司将于2026年12月16日召开第32届常年股东大会。
risks: 执行董事 Dato' Leong Sai Mun 在闭市期间多次申报增持公司股份。
需在股东大会上寻求批准。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，公司营收为1019.2万令吉，净利为247.9万令吉，净利率24.3%；营收按季增长23.8%，净利按季增长52.3%，净利率较上季的19.8%有所提升。

recent_en: In November 2026, Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad proposed the acquisition of Q Centre Management to expand into worker accommodation management, and reported a 52.3% QoQ rise in net profit to RM2.479 million for the first quarter of FY2027. The company also announced its 32nd AGM to be held on 16 December 2026, while several directors reported dealings in shares during the closed period.
notable_en: The company proposed the acquisition of Q Centre Management to move into worker accommodation management.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 52.3% QoQ to RM2.479 million.
risks_en: Executive Director Dato' Leong Sai Mun reported multiple acquisitions of company shares during the closed period.
The company proposed to grant Share Issuance Scheme options to Executive Director Dato' Leong Sai Mun, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.192 million and net profit was RM2.479 million, with a net margin of 24.3%; revenue rose 23.8% QoQ and net profit rose 52.3% QoQ, while net margin improved from 19.8% in the previous quarter.
